messages:
Priya Raman: getting an escalated ticket + alerts from phoenix-corp about huge tail latency on text-gen in us-east. p95 jumped to ~1.9s and p99 to ~5.5s around 2026-03-22T14:05Z after the v3.4 canary.

latency-bot: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/stack?from=now-30m&to=now annotated at 14:05 deploy

Tomas Alvarez: thanks, digging traces. Any error spike? 4xx/5xx normal?

Priya Raman: errors steady. This is purely tail - CPU/GPU not saturated but scheduler queue depth doubled and avg batch size climbed.

Nikhil Rao: recall v3.4 enabled fallback-kernel which merges KV reads and can increase per-token cost when context churns. Could be kernel selection change.

Ava Brooks: I'm on infra. Checking autoscaler and runtime logs for config diffs around canary. Also checking if batching.max_inflight or max_batch_size changed.

infra-bot: Config audit: rollout/v3.4 -> batching.max_batch_size from 64 -> 192 (canary patch). Also runtime.kernel.policy changed: prefer_fused_attention = true.

Tomas Alvarez: 192?!?! that's a large jump. That would explain queueing and higher tail.

Priya Raman: customer reports began at 14:06. We need immediate mitigation that's low-risk.

Nikhil Rao: mitigation plan (rapid):
- 1) reduce max_batch_size for v3.4 canary to 48
- 2) enable per-model soft rate limit (req/s) and per-route circuit-breaker to shed traffic to v3-stable
- 3) start a 25% weight diversion to v3-stable (quantized q8) while we observe
- 4) if no improvement in 10m, spin up a dedicated small-gpu pool and pin hot customers to it

Priya Raman: ok I'll implement 1 & 2. Tomas, can you apply the route split?

Tomas Alvarez: running:
```
redwoodctl runtime patch --model v3.4 --set batching.max_batch_size=48 --reason "hotfix reduce batch due to tail"
redwoodctl runtime patch --model v3.4 --set runtime.rate_limit.soft=200 --set runtime.circuit_breaker.enabled=true
```

ops-bot: Applied runtime patches to region us-east-1. change_id=cfg-20260322-01. Propagate ~45s.

latency-bot: 60s after change: p95 -> 1.1s, p99 -> 2.7s. Improvement but borderline.

Tomas Alvarez: applying traffic split to v3-stable q8:
```
redwoodctl traffic split set --region us-east --primary v3.4 --secondary v3-stable-q8 --secondary-weight 25
```

ops-bot: Traffic split active. 75% v3.4 / 25% v3-stable-q8.

latency-bot: Post-split (5m): p95 0.85s, p99 1.5s. Customer complaints dropping.

support-bot: Phoenix-corp: "latency improved, thanks" (support ticket updated)

Ava Brooks: quick longer-term guard we should add: deploy-time preflight that runs a synthetic tail test (100 concurrent sessions with 1-4k tokens) and compares p99 vs previous model. Block deploy if p99 increases by > 30%.

Nikhil Rao: also suggestion: add a rollout manifest field to cap batching.max_batch_size delta percentage (e.g., no >50% increase without manual signoff).

Priya Raman: creating immediate SLO guard: if model p99 > 2.0s for 3 consecutive 2m windows, auto-divert 50% traffic to fallback region (us-west) and open 120s breaker. Command:
```
redwoodctl gateway set-guard --name p99-divert-v3.4 --metric p99_latency --threshold 2.0 --consecutive_windows 3 --window_seconds 120 --divert_percent 50 --fallback_region us-west-2
```

ops-bot: Guard p99-divert-v3.4 configured.

Tomas Alvarez: also temporarily lowered per-customer concurrency on the public API route to 10 where we saw the most load to reduce q buildup. Command:
```
redwoodctl quota update --route /v1/generate --concurrency_per_customer 10
```

ops-bot: quota applied.

latency-bot: After all mitigations p95 0.78s, p99 1.3s over 15m. Marking as mitigated.

Priya Raman: follow-ups (owners):
- postmortem doc (owner: Priya) with timeline, config diff, and rollback criteria 14:00 EOD
- infra RFC to add preflight tail test + batch delta guard (owner: Ava)
- add canary monitor that watches avg_batch_size and p99 together and alerts at correlation (owner: Nikhil)
- update runbook "latency-tail-regressions" with quick commands and routing examples (owner: Tomas)

Ava Brooks: I'll put a hotfix to manifest templates so future rollouts default batch delta to <=20% unless explicit override.

Nikhil Rao: considering a "fast-path" model variant for latency-sensitive customers (lower precision + smaller kv-window) to route them automatically.

Priya Raman: please add customer-facing comms template to support-runbook. We had one for errors but not for latency-specific wording.

Tomas Alvarez: PRs: infra/rollout-guards (WIP), docs/runbooks/latency (WIP). I'll link in the postmortem.

priya: Confirming stable 14:40Z. Closing thread, will attach postmortem link when ready.

ops-bot: Change set: cfg-20260322-01, traffic-split-025, guard-p99-divert-v3.4

Priya Raman: closing. If anyone sees re-escalation, please reopen or ping #pager.
